nodes.excerpt: Driven superconductors contain nonequilibrium quasiparticles, phonons and order-parameter suppression whose coupled relaxation controls kinetic inductance, switching and photon detection.

nodes.excerpt: Operando methods correlate structure and intermediates with catalytic performance under the same working state, but correlation alone does not establish causal activity.

nodes.title: Optical Absorption, Joint Density of States and Selection Rules

nodes.excerpt: An absorption edge is the product of available initial–final state pairs and their optical matrix elements, so dimensionality and symmetry shape the spectrum.

nodes.title: Optimization, Gradient Descent and Backpropagation
nodes.titleZh: 优化、梯度下降与反向传播
nodes.excerpt: Learning algorithms search parameter space using noisy local information; backpropagation computes gradients efficiently but does not guarantee a useful solution.

nodes.title: Optoelectronic Devices Knowledge Network
nodes.titleZh: 光电子器件知识网络

nodes.titleZh: 光电存储、光忆阻与可重构器件

nodes.title: Optoelectronic Devices: LEDs, Photodiodes, and Solar Cells
nodes.titleZh: 光电子器件：LED、光电二极管与太阳电池

nodes.title: Phonons, Lattice Dynamics and Electron–Phonon Coupling
nodes.titleZh: 声子、晶格动力学与电子–声子耦合

nodes.title: Photoconductors and Phototransistors

nodes.titleZh: 响应率、探测率、噪声、带宽与增益权衡

nodes.title: Photoelectrochemistry, Solar Fuels and Water Splitting

nodes.titleZh: 太阳电池、准费米能级与详细平衡极限

nodes.title: PIN Photodiodes

nodes.title: Battery Thermodynamics, Porous Electrodes and Degradation
nodes.titleZh: 电池热力学、多孔电极与衰减

nodes.title: Power Semiconductor Devices
nodes.titleZh: 功率半导体器件

nodes.title: Pretraining Data: Quality, Deduplication and Mixture Design
nodes.titleZh: 预训练数据：质量、去重与混合设计

nodes.title: Probabilistic and Bayesian Machine Learning
nodes.titleZh: 概率机器学习与贝叶斯推断

nodes.title: Quantum Capacitance in Two-Dimensional Devices
nodes.titleZh: 二维器件中的量子电容

nodes.title: Quantum Chemistry, Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding
nodes.titleZh: 量子化学、电子结构与化学键
nodes.excerpt: Chemical bonding and reactivity arise from the many-electron wavefunction or density under nuclear potentials, but useful predictions depend on controlled approximations and error cancellation.

nodes.title: Quantum Dots, Spin–Valley Qubits and Topological Candidates
nodes.titleZh: 量子点、自旋–谷量子比特与拓扑候选器件
nodes.excerpt: Electrostatic confinement discretizes 2D electronic states; spin, valley, layer or parity can encode quantum information and couple to gates, resonators or superconductors.

nodes.title: Quantum Hall and Topological Edge States
nodes.titleZh: 量子霍尔与拓扑边缘态
nodes.excerpt: Landau quantization or nontrivial band topology can create bulk gaps with conducting boundary channels protected against selected scattering processes.

nodes.title: Quantum Phase Transitions, Critical Scaling and Quantum Fluctuations
nodes.titleZh: 量子相变、临界标度与量子涨落
nodes.excerpt: A quantum phase transition is driven by a nonthermal control parameter at zero temperature, with quantum fluctuations generating finite-temperature scaling and unconventional dynamics.

nodes.title: Quantum Tunneling in Semiconductor Devices
nodes.titleZh: 半导体器件中的量子隧穿

nodes.title: Quantum-Well and Quantum-Dot Lasers with VCSELs
nodes.titleZh: 量子阱、量子点激光器与 VCSEL

nodes.title: Quasiparticles, Self-Energy and Landau Fermi Liquids
nodes.titleZh: 准粒子、自能与朗道费米液体

nodes.title: Redox-Flow Batteries and Molecular Electrolytes
nodes.titleZh: 液流电池与分子电解液

nodes.title: Reduced Dielectric Screening in Two Dimensions
nodes.titleZh: 二维体系中的弱介电屏蔽
nodes.excerpt: Field lines around an atomically thin layer extend into its environment, so electron–electron and electron–hole interactions are nonlocal and strongly substrate dependent.

nodes.title: Resistive RAM and Conductive-Filament Dynamics
nodes.titleZh: 阻变存储器与导电细丝动力学
nodes.excerpt: RRAM switches resistance by redistributing ions and defects, often forming or rupturing a nanoscale metallic or oxygen-vacancy-rich conduction path.

nodes.title: Resonant and Interlayer Tunneling Devices
nodes.titleZh: 共振与层间隧穿器件

nodes.title: Two-Dimensional Superconductivity and Josephson Physics
nodes.titleZh: 二维超导与约瑟夫森物理
